# Template: lewis_dot
A Lewis dot (electron dot) structure for one of eight common molecules — water, carbon dioxide, oxygen, nitrogen, ammonia, methane, hydrogen chloride, or sodium chloride — using a hand-placed canned geometry per molecule: element-symbol atoms connected by single/double/triple bonds (drawn as 1-3 short parallel strokes), each atom's correct lone-pair count shown as small paired dots, and — for the ionic pair NaCl — square brackets with +/- charges when requested. Choose this scene for ANY request about a Lewis structure, an electron-dot diagram, valence electrons, lone pairs, covalent or ionic bonding, or an octet-rule diagram for one of these eight molecules.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "molecule": {
   "type": "string",
   "enum": [
    "H2O",
    "CO2",
    "O2",
    "N2",
    "NH3",
    "CH4",
    "HCl",
    "NaCl"
   ],
   "description": "Which molecule to draw (closed set v1; default H2O)."
  },
  "show_lone_pairs": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Show lone-pair dots (default true)."
  },
  "show_charges": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Show NaCl's ionic brackets and +/- charges (default false). Only affects NaCl."
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- atom_<i>: an atom's element-symbol text, 0-indexed per the molecule's canned geometry
- bond_<i>: the i-th bond — 1 stroke for single, 2 for double, 3 for triple (one group)
- lp_<atom>_<k>: the k-th lone pair (a group of 2 dots) on atom index <atom>
- charge_<i>: NaCl's ionic bracket + charge symbol for atom i, present only for NaCl when show_charges
Examples:
Request: "Draw the Lewis structure of water." → params: {"molecule":"H2O"}
Request: "Draw the Lewis structure of sodium chloride showing the ionic charges." → params: {"molecule":"NaCl","show_charges":true}

In YAML: `template: lewis_dot` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
